# WBS Epic: Validation Domains

This epic owns the application of the framework to high-stakes domains. Slice 3 commits to legal document summarization. Later slices target additional domains.

## Acceptance

- One domain (legal doc summarization) ships a Slice 3 report
- The report captures the hesitation factor at every decision point
- Findings feed back into the COTS schema and the framework's evidence schemas
- A second domain is selected and started with a CR-based approach

## Children

- [ ] Story: Pick the legal-document corpus and jurisdiction — Slice 3
- [ ] Story: Build the practitioner panel pipeline — Slice 3
- [ ] Task: Capture hesitation-factor findings at each decision point — Slice 3
- [ ] Story: Author the Slice 3 report — Slice 3
- [ ] Story: Pick the second domain — Slice 6 (depends on Slice 3 report)
